# Linkar52 — PKNS Property Microsite

## About
Linkar52 is a residential transit-oriented development (TOD) by PKNS 
(Perbadanan Kemajuan Negeri Selangor), a Selangor state government corporation.
Located in Seksyen 14, Shah Alam, Selangor, Malaysia.

## Key Facts
- Developer: Perbadanan Kemajuan Negeri Selangor (PKNS)
- Project Name: Linkar52
- Type: Residential apartments (Transit-Oriented Development)
- Location: Seksyen 14, Shah Alam, Selangor, 40000, Malaysia
- Total Units: 615 units
- LRT Access: 50 metres to Stesen LRT Dato' Menteri (Kelana Jaya Line)
- Highway Access: 100 metres to Federal Highway (Lebuhraya Persekutuan)
- Nearby: Shah Alam Convention Centre, Avisena Specialist Hospital Shah Alam, PKNS HQ

## Unit Types
- Type A: Studio / Small unit
- Type B: 2-bedroom
- Type B2A: 2-bedroom variant
- Type C: 3-bedroom
- Type D: Larger unit
- Type E: Premium unit

## Facilities
- Swimming pool
- Gymnasium
- Multipurpose hall
- Retail shops (ground floor commercial)
- Covered parking
- 24-hour security
